FN-JPX79YF-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 292
Committee: Military and Veterans' Affairs Sponsor: Representative Rick Rehm
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 01/22/2026
House Bill 292 as introduced would reduce annual motor vehicle registration receipts to various
local licensing officials and the Department of Corrections by an estimated $27,000,
cumulatively, by lowering the disability rating threshold for receiving a disabled veteran license
plate.

House Bill 292
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Representative Rick Rehm
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/11/2026
House Bill 292 as passed the House of Representatives would reduce annual motor vehicle
registration receipts to various local licensing officials and the Department of Corrections by an
estimated $27,000, cumulatively, by lowering the disability rating threshold for receiving a
disabled veteran license plate.
